subject: Scheduling: Redwood demo for Acme Robotics - multi-timezone coordination
messages:
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Miranda Lee <miranda@acme.com>, Oliver Tan <oliver.tan@acme.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T18:14:00Z
Subject: Intro + demo request: Redwood inference

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the intro  we're excited to see Redwood in action. We're trying to coordinate a demo that includes our SRE/engineering team (Priya), procurement (Miranda), and security (Oliver). We also have folks in EU and APAC who will join where possible. Can your team propose a few rotating windows so we can maximize overlap across US/EU/APAC?

Rough constraints from our side (attached sheet):
- Preferred days: Tue/Thu
- Core US engineering overlap: 08:00-12:00 PT
- EU engineering overlap: 16:00-19:00 CET
- APAC limited to late evening / early morning SGT (can join up to 01:30 SGT)

Also please include an SE for technical Q&A and a brief agenda (30	145m).

Cheers,
Samir Khan
Senior Staff Engineer
Acme Robotics

Attachment: acme_availability.xlsx (spreadsheet with team availability)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T21:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request: Redwood inference

Samir  thanks for the details and the availability sheet. Hi all  Chloe (AE) here, looping in Ethan (SE) and Aditya (manager) for capacity.

We can do a 30	145m demo + 15m for procurement/security Q&A. To cover US/EU/APAC, here are two rotating options (times shown with conversions):

Option A (earlier for US, late for APAC):
- Tue Mar 2 09:00 PT / 18:00 CET / Wed Mar 3 01:00 SGT
- 45m demo + 15m Q&A

Option B (later for EU, friendly to APAC):
- Thu Mar 4 08:00 PT / 17:00 CET / Fri Mar 5 01:00 SGT
- 45m demo + 15m Q&A

If those windows don't work we can do a rotating cadence (e.g., one demo at a US-friendly time, next at EU/APAC-friendly time)  happy to set that expectation.

Proposed agenda (high level):
1) 5m intros + success criteria
2) 20	25m live demo (inference runtime, latency/cost controls, routing/fallback)  Ethan will cover
3) 10m deployment/ops/questions (Dedicated/Private options, SSO/KMS)
4) 10m procurement/security Q&A (SOC2, audit logs, data residency)

I'll attach a short agenda and our SOC2 summary; Ethan, flag any changes.

Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.docx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-27T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request: Redwood inference

Thanks Chloe A agenda looks good. Quick notes from the SE side:
- We'll demo a live inference flow showing routing/fallback between a hosted and a quantized dedicated variant. Recommend 45m to show a short end-to-end and then toggle policies.
- I won't be available after 22:00 CET on demo days (travel). If Option A lands at 18:00 CET that's fine; Option B at 17:00 CET is also fine. If we move later than 22:00 CET I may need to drop to async notes.
- Can Priya and Samir list any specific integrations (KMS, SSO provider) you want covered?

Happy to add a short demo script to the agenda if helpful.

Ethan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

- Standard terms / PO wiring instructions and an estimate ballpark for a 3-month pilot (expected token volume: ~125M tokens/month)

Appreciate the quick turn on calendar slots.
